model_annotation: The line plot in Figure 4 displays the performance of knowledge probing accuracy after editing with different editing methods on BioMedLM, where "Base" denotes LLM without editing. The x-axis represents Co-occurrence Number on a logarithmic scale with values from $10^{0}$ to $10^{3}$ and units not specified. The y-axis represents ACC (%) on a linear scale with values from 40 to 65 and units %. There are six lines in the plot: Base, a black line with circle markers and a solid line style; FT, a purple line with triangle markers and a dashed line style; MEND, a red line with square markers and a dotted line style; MEMIT, a blue line with diamond markers and a dash-dot line style; ROME, a green line with pentagon markers and a solid line style; and IRE, a brown line with star markers and a dashed line style. Starting from the left side of the plot, or at a Co-occurrence Number of approximately $10^{0}$, the ACC values are: Base about 42; FT about 42; IRE about 42; MEND approximately 42; MEMIT about 42; and ROME about 42. At the right side of the plot or at a Co-occurrence Number of $10^{3}$, the ACC values are: Base approximately 51; FT approximately 51; IRE approximately 58; MEND approximately 60; MEMIT approximately 61; and ROME approximately 64. The plot shows an increase in ACC across all editing methods as Co-occurrence Number increases.
